pr_title: planner: fix generated column causes a server crash
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:

2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #15992 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:
Consider the following statements:
```sql
CREATE TABLE t0(c0 INT, c1 INT AS (c0));
CREATE INDEX i0 ON t0(c1);
SELECT t0.c0 FROM t0 UNION ALL SELECT 0 FROM t0;
```

The c1.virtualExpr will point to c0.
If we change c0 to c1, then the c1.virtualExpr will be c1. This is wrong and makes the server crash when extractColumn.

### What is changed and how it works?

When setting the `virtualExpr` for the virtual generated column, clone the expression.

### Related changes



### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->


- Integration test


Side effects


### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->
Fix generated column causes a server crash.

```sql
CREATE TABLE t0(c0 INT, c1 INT AS (c0));
CREATE INDEX i0 ON t0(c1);
SELECT /*+ USE_INDEX_MERGE(t0, c0_2) */ t0.c0 FROM t0 UNION ALL SELECT 0 FROM t0;
```
